scope: Desktop business dialogs and the Web client that embeds Desktop App

alreadyCustom: Prompt batch tags and folder menu

preservedPlatformBoundaries.reason: OS tray confirmation and outcome when the main window can be hidden; 2 showMessageBox calls.
Startup failure before a renderer is available: showErrorBox; native file/folder selection remains OS integration.
beforeunload protects dirty content during browser close/reload; does not use the business-confirmation API.
Separate React Native application: 2 Alert.alert calls and web alert/confirm fallbacks were inventoried, not migrated.

changes: A transient renderer confirmation owner and one host reuse ConfirmDialog in Desktop App, including embedded Web workspace.
All asynchronous decisions are awaited; cancellation and host disposal settle pending continuations.
ConfirmDialog uses localized default actions, traps focus including message controls, respects focused Cancel on Enter, isolates modal keyboard events, and blocks loading backdrop dismissal.
Prompt batch deletion rejects duplicate submissions and reports failures without a success toast.
Gallery retains batch selection until removed records disappear.

verification.boundary: Component tests exercise real UI actions with mocked external boundaries. Prompt batch integration exercises preload/registered IPC with temporary SQLite, readback and reopen; the deletion-failure test injects failure at the action boundary.
